feeds.title: Uttam Gupta » Fertilizers
feeds.description: Dr. Uttam Gupta is an expert and author of several books. He talks on a wide range of topics. He is a chief economist in the Fertilizer Association of India, a unique apex body of fertilizer manufacturer. Follow his blog to keep up with the latest Fertilizer industry updates from India.

feeds.title: Soil Health Nexus Blog
feeds.description: The North Central Region Soil Health Nexus was initiated in 2015 with funding from the North Central Region Water Network. A North Central Soil Health Work Group with representatives from Land Grant Universities across the 12 state region convened to address the challenges of increasing access to soil health research, knowledge, extension and resources.

feeds.title: Garden Myths » Fertilizer
feeds.description: Garden Myths is a blog dedicated to unearthing the truth about gardening. It will look at common and not so common myths and debunk them. The goal of this blog is to provide you with a better understanding of how your plants live and breathe.

feeds.title: EMNZ Organic Fertiliser Blog
feeds.description: EMNZ promotes the use of Effective Microorganisms (EM) in Agriculture & Horticulture, Garden and around the home. EM is the unique composition of a diverse group of bacteria, yeasts, and fungi.

feeds.title: Griffin Fertilizer Blog
feeds.description: Griffin Fertilizer Company, a division of Ben Hill Griffin, Inc., is a full-service custom dry & liquid fertilizer blender and crop protection products, distributor. Griffin Fertilizer has been committed to helping its customers make sound agronomic and economic decisions to maximize their crop yields.

feeds.title: Indogulf BioAg Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about organic fertilizers, biological inoculants to maximize growth and yield. Indogulf BioAg is a Biotechnology division under the Indogulf group and is a pioneer in manufacturing bio-organic fertilizers in India.

feeds.title: Anji Fertilizer's
feeds.description: Anji Fertilizer's Blogspot talks about everything related to fertilizers. It starts with its creation, usage, importance and many more. It's a very helpful site for people who do not know anything about it.
